audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Volibear all seven rows while the win rate is 47.26% over 603 games — the packet itself flags the contradiction, and the already-audited mirror (kayle__volibear) settled the chart as Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle. diffRating 4/10 and carryRating 6/10 also contradicted diff='HARD' and a losing win rate.
audit.why: Kayle scales out of the matchup: her passive grants attack range as she levels, Divine Judgment drops to 80s at rank 3, and Celestial Blessing (15s) undoes chip. Volibear's edge is levels 1-2 and a race after that.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-3 Skill, rows 4-6 Kayle on both layers; ratings dropped to match; difficulty 6/10, Kayle carry threat 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Volibear's strongest window with no mention that Divine Judgment answers the dive, and the two-item phase claimed Volibear is a drain-tank Kayle cannot burst.
audit.why: Divine Judgment makes the target invulnerable and rains damage around them, 160/120/80s — it is the direct counter to a Stormbringer dive. Volibear's real spikes stay levels 2-5 and Sundered Sky; Kayle's are her passive range steps and item timings.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].why and the level-6 spike now name Divine Judgment as the answer to the dive and put the leap after she burns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was called a 'dash' with a 'root'. Riot's text: he gains speed towards enemies and Stuns the first one he Attacks — a run-down whose stun lands on the attack. Kayle's Radiant Blast resistance shred and Celestial Blessing's heal were never stated.
audit.why: A player who thinks Q is a dash mistimes the stun and walks into a 900-range Radiant Blast that shreds his resistances before the bite lands. Frenzied Maul (5s) marks first and only heals on the second cast into the same mark.
audit.corrected: Q is a run-down, stun on the attack; Radiant Blast is 900 range / 12s and shreds resistances; Celestial Blessing is a 15s heal that undoes slow trades.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling as a first back is right here — Celestial Blessing is a real heal on a 15s cooldown — but the text said 'his' twice for a female champion.

edits.before: Crush her early — Q-stun all-in before she scales. Volibear wins by trading around Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln) and cashing the pattern: bully her early and deny her scaling.
edits.after: Crush her early — she is melee until her passive gives her range. Run her down with Thundering Smash and double-bite the mark; once she has two items and Divine Judgment at 80s, the lane is gone.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Kayle Divine Judgment: Makes an ally INVULNERABLE briefly, then bursts around them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment (R): 160s at rank 1, down to 80s at rank 3 — it makes the target invulnerable and rains damage around them. Bait it, then Q-stun. - Radiant Blast (Q): 12s at rank 1, 900 range, shreds resistances.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment (Invuln) and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by whether you end it before her passive turns her ranged and untouchable.

edits.before: Carry threat: 6/10. If Kayle gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 8/10. If Kayle gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: Late game Stormbringer is a teamfight reset — leap on the backline, shred the tower in dives, and let the lightning passive carry extended brawls. Kayle carry threat: 6/10 — end the game before she cashes it.
edits.after: Late game Stormbringer is a teamfight reset — leap on the backline, shred the tower in dives, and let the lightning passive carry extended brawls. Kayle carry threat: 8/10 — end the game before she cashes it.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion  (vs his poke). Core: Sundered Sky  (the all-in sustain spike), then Spirit Visage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts his healing.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion  (vs her poke). Core: Sundered Sky  (the all-in sustain spike), then Spirit Visage; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Executioner's Calling (≈800g) — cuts her healing.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Kayle under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: E completes the pattern: shield yourself in the blast and slow her escape. Your kill window is open, but Celestial Blessing (15s) undoes a slow trade.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Kayle down every time Divine Judgment (Invuln) is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Radiant Blast (900 range, 12s) shreds your resistances from outside your reach — commit only when she has used it.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Kayle under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables her tower on landing, but Divine Judgment answers the dive with invulnerability — force the leap only after she burns it.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Kayle to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky still heals on the first hit, but her item spike outpaces it — take the wave and objectives instead of forcing a fight.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Kayle can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items she out-ranges and out-DPSes you; Divine Judgment is down to 80s at rank 3, so pick her off the map instead of trading in her range.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 80s at rank 3 — a late all-in just feeds her the reset.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — both are melee with no combo advantage yet.
edits.after: Level 1 favours you — she is melee here with no combo yet.

edits.before: At 2 your Q dash lets you pressure the weak early Kayle.
edits.after: At 2 Thundering Smash runs her down and your hit stuns.

edits.before: Level 3 your full combo runs down the melee, unscaled Kayle.
edits.after: Level 3 is a race: your all-in versus her Celestial Blessing heal.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep suppressing her before her power spikes.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out as her Radiant Blast shred starts to bite.

edits.before: Level 6 your R dive still beats her, just respect her R invuln.
edits.after: Level 6 Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable through your dive.

edits.before: At first item you're still ahead while her ranged spike looms.
edits.after: At first item her scaling arrives and your kill window closes.

edits.before: You own the early game — Kayle is melee and weak until 6/11, so land Q Thundering Smash root into W Frenzied Maul and try to end the lane before she comes online.
edits.after: You own the early game — she is melee and unscaled, so run her down with Thundering Smash, stun on the attack, then Frenzied Maul twice on the mark before she comes online.

notes: tone is '#3ddc97' (green/favoured) on a HARD matchup with a 47.26% win rate — the colour token contradicts the difficulty. Left alone because there is no verified tone-to-tier mapping; QA should set it to the HARD tier colour. The packet's suspect names 'Divine Ascent's' and 'Divine Judgment's' are false positives (possessives). Volibear's E carries a 'projectile' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text (a bolt summoned at a location), so no Wind Wall claim was written. Existing content asserts Kayle spikes at '6/11'; the kit only says her passive grants range as she levels, so I did not repeat the level-11 number in any rewritten string.
